assets.name: catcher
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: transparent baseball game character cutout. Full body adult baseball catcher in a low realistic squat, viewed STRICTLY FROM BEHIND, BACK OF HELMET AND BACK OF JERSEY toward camera; catcher faces away from viewer toward pitcher. Slight elevated camera, no face visible. Teal jersey, gray trousers, navy helmet and shin guards, tan catcher's mitt extended forward away from viewer to receive pitch. Realistic anatomy, padded chest protector straps visible across back, detailed fabric and equipment. Entire player from helmet to cleats with transparent padding all sides. Empty transparent background, no floor no stadium no shadows no words no logos. High fidelity photographic sports game asset.

assets.name: astronaut
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent animation sprite sheet for photorealistic cinematic science fiction side-scroller. EXACT 3 columns by 2 rows, SIX equal cells; each cell contains ONE full-body same astronaut at same scale, identical equipment, same profile camera, facing RIGHT. Ivory-gray pressure suit with realistic fabric folds, segmented joints, worn navy knee pads, small orange shoulder panels, compact rectangular life-support backpack, gold reflective enclosed helmet. Row1: relaxed standing idle, walking right with left foot forward, walking right with feet passing. Row2: walking right with right foot forward, walking right with feet passing other half, airborne jumping with both knees bent. Photoreal detailed film prop costume, subtle cool teal rim light, restrained warm front light. Feet aligned to common baseline in every cell except jumping pose at similar body placement. Generous transparent margins separating each cell. No character or equipment crosses a cell boundary. Transparent background. NO grid NO words NO labels NO scenery NO floor. Precise side profile, no view toward camera.

assets.name: orbit
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: cinematic deep space backdrop for a realistic 3D side-scrolling orbital station game. Wide 2:1 landscape. View from low orbit: immense blue and jade ocean planet with detailed white swirling cloud systems, curved limb crossing lower two thirds of image, warm sunrise at far left edge, electric blue thin atmosphere, black starfield in upper third with fine subtle pinprick stars. On far right edge a very distant thin orbital ring arc glints in sunlight. No station, no interior, no characters, no foreground structures, no UI, no text. Grounded high-budget science fiction film photography, rich color, convincing scale, sharp atmospheric detail, controlled exposure, not cartoon.

assets.name: bulkhead
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: repeating background wall texture for a realistic science fiction game corridor. Wide 2:1 orthographic straight-on photo of ONE modular dark steel industrial spacecraft bulkhead panel. Rectangular inset maintenance hatches, tiny bolts, narrow ventilation slots, ribbed cable conduits, aged charcoal metal with subtle scuffs and roughness. A restrained narrow teal indicator strip and one tiny amber status light. Even diffuse cool lighting with baked subtle contact shadows. NO perspective, NO floor, NO ceiling, NO people, NO windows, NO words, NO numbers, NO logos, NO danger symbols. Edges are plain continuous dark metal so identical modules may be placed side-by-side without strong seams. Dense convincing physical detail, subtle contrast, practical spaceship architecture, photorealistic.
